bias.en: Bearish, improving · above the 10-day, under the 30-day and SAR
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 站上 10 日均线，仍低于 30 日均线和 SAR

read.en: Broadcom rose 4.0% on Oct 27 to $342.33, trading between $336.87 and $345.67. It is above the falling 5-day ($330.8) and 10-day ($334.3) and below the falling 30-day ($349.2), 100-day ($372.2) and 200-day ($367.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 15 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($349.81), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: 博通 10月27日上涨 4.0%，收于 $342.33，盘中区间 $336.87–345.67。股价位于下行的 5 日（$330.8）和 10 日均线（$334.3）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$349.2）、100 日（$372.2）和 200 日均线（$367.8）。MACD 自 10月15日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$349.81），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The close cleared $331, $335.8 (10-day, Sep 16 low) and $341.1 (Oct 20 high), now support. Resistance is $344.3–345.7 (Oct 15 close, Oct 27 high), then $349.2–349.8 (30-day, SAR) and $354.3 (Oct 14 high). Support is $339.2–341.1 (Oct 20–21 highs), then $334.3–336.9 (10-day, Oct 27 low) and $330.8 (5-day). A close above $349.8 would target $354; below $334, $331.

s.en: Oct 20 and Oct 21 highs ($339.2–341.1), now support
